rows.name_as_written: Round 10 release of the FinnGen consortium
rows.quote: The summary-level GWAS data for POAG were extracted from the latest Round 10 release of the FinnGen consortium (8,530 cases and 391,275 controls) (https://r10.finngen.fi/) and the UK Biobank (4,737 cases and 458,196 controls), respectively.
rows.coder_note: 'Round 10 release of the FinnGen consortium' (and the r10.finngen.fi address) is FinnGen R10 written in another form (rule A); nothing conflicts.

The POAG GWAS is given as 'the UK Biobank (4,737 cases and 458,196 controls)' with a citation to the general cohort description (Sudlow 2015); no accession, pipeline or GWAS citation, and counts with a cohort name alone do not identify a release (rules D, I1).

rows.quote: DeCODE reported the pQTL data of 4,907 plasma proteins measured in 35,559 Icelanders with SomaScan version four and UKB-PPP presented comprehensive pQTL mapping of 2,923 proteins measured from 54,219 UK Biobank participants using the Olink platform (Ferkingstad et al., 2021; Sun et al., 2023).
rows.coder_note: 35,559 Icelanders with SomaScan version four and 4,907 proteins match the Ferkingstad 2021 row exactly (the Eldjarn 2023 deCODE row has 35,892); the sentence also names Ferkingstad et al., 2021.

Sun et al., 2023 (doi 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6) has four dictionary rows; the sentence's attributes (2,923 proteins, Olink, 54,219 UK Biobank participants) match the sample size of none of them, so no row is separated (rule E).
